change: Replace an immediately adjacent local.set v / local.get v with local.tee v. The local write remains; only the redundant reload is removed.
invariant: Match the same virtual register and the exact byte position after its previous local.set. Any intervening instruction, including a control-flow boundary, prevents folding. Reset state per function; consume the match once.
